paper_title: First Searches for Axions and Axion-Like Particles with the LUX Experiment
notes: LUX 2013 (95 live-days x 118 kg) axio-electric search. Galactic ALP limit g_Ae < 4.2e-13 (90% C.L.) across 1-16 keV/c^2, assuming ALPs constitute all galactic dark matter (dm_density ~0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed as standard). Emitted galactic ALP result as a flat line over the stated 1-16 keV mass range. Note: paper also reports a mass-independent solar-axion limit g_Ae < 3.5e-12 (not DM, not emitted here).
